description.narrative: The Australia Online Studies Scholarship Cohort for the 2021 Intake. The Australia Online Studies Scholarships supports the delivery of distance education within Samoa, facilitating skills development while retaining the student in country particularly where candidates with family and work responsibilities, especially women, wish to continue current employment. Consistent with the goal and objectives of the Australia Awards, the goals of the AOSS is to develop capacity and leadership skills so that individuals can contribute to Samoa's development and build people-to-people linkages at the individual, institutional and country levels. This investment supports the 2021 intake.

description.narrative: The Australia Online Study Scholarships (AOSS) provides capacity building opportunities for Samoan professionals who wish to obtain an online postgraduate qualification from an Australian university. This category supplements broader Australia Award offerings, catering to applicants unable to travel for studies due to work and personal commitments. ‍ Annually, Australia offers up to 10 online scholarships, covering 97% of tuition fees. A new investment is created for each new intake of scholarships. ‍ For the 2021 Intake, 10 awards were offered (9 females, 1 non-binary). To date, 7 awardees have successfully completed their programs, 3 in the reporting period. Qualifications obtained include master’s degrees in: Strategic People Management, Environmental Management & Development, Applied Economics, Evaluation and Project Management. ‍ Several awardees of the 2021 Intake occupy managerial roles in key government agencies, including the Public Service Commission and Development Bank of Samoa. Their qualifications have enhanced their ability to contribute to Samoa’s national development priorities. Additionally, qualifications attained have enabled career progression for awardees within important organisations such as the Ministry of Finance, National Provident Fund, and the private sector. ‍ By providing opportunities for Samoans to upskill at Australian institutions whilst remaining in Samoa, AOSS is responding to Samoa’s workforce challenges.

The Australian Online Study Scholarship (AOSS) program provides opportunities to Samoan professionals who wish to complete a master degree but are unable to travel to Australia due to existing commitments at home. Scholars are supported with the provision of 97% of tuition fees and are required to maintain a part time load to enable to work and study concurrently. Australia’s investment value for AOSS 2021 allows for 10 scholarships in this intake. ‍ During the reporting period, two graduates were supported under the AOSS program, and have completed postgraduate degrees in project management and evaluation to strengthen leadership capabilities. Graduates from this intake are currently employed in high priority sector for the Government of Samoa: community sector and finance sector.
